title.narrative: 1.1.1 Indicator to Output 1 of story written by Justice Reports of conflict victims/survivors

description.narrative: Justice Reporters who are capacitated through the implementation of SAHAS first and second phase will be further capacitated to write stories using narrative therapy approach. The selected Justice Reporters (at least 8 eight) will write the stories of conflict survivors ( women, girls, boys, men, LGBTIQ, people with disability) and publish them in the form of book in collaboration with local governments.

comment.narrative: Justice Reporters who are capacitated through the implementation of SAHAS first and second phase will be further capacitated to write stories using narrative therapy approach. The selected Justice Reporters at least 8 eight will write the stories of conflict survivors women girls boys men LGBTIQ people with disability and publish them in the form of book in collaboration with local governments. Through this action it is expected to publish eight small booklets that has stories of conflict survivors however the number of stories in each book will be decided by the Justice reporters with support from TSK.
